question: Analyze the average percentage change in sales between the 12 weeks before and after June 15, 2020, for each attribute type: region, platform, age band, demographic, and customer type. For each attribute type, calculate the average percentage change in sales across all its attribute values. Identify the attribute type with the highest negative impact on sales and provide its average percentage change in sales.
sql:
WITH before_region AS (
  SELECT region, AVG(sales::DOUBLE) as avg_before
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date < '2020-06-15'
  GROUP BY region
),
after_region AS (
  SELECT region, AVG(sales::DOUBLE) as avg_after
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date > '2020-06-15'
  GROUP BY region
),
region_pct AS (
  SELECT (a.avg_after - b.avg_before) / b.avg_before * 100 as pct_change
  FROM before_region b JOIN after_region a ON b.region = a.region
),
before_platform AS (
  SELECT platform, AVG(sales::DOUBLE) as avg_before
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date < '2020-06-15'
  GROUP BY platform
),
after_platform AS (
  SELECT platform, AVG(sales::DOUBLE) as avg_after
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date > '2020-06-15'
  GROUP BY platform
),
platform_pct AS (
  SELECT (a.avg_after - b.avg_before) / b.avg_before * 100 as pct_change
  FROM before_platform b JOIN after_platform a ON b.platform = a.platform
),
before_age_band AS (
  SELECT age_band, AVG(sales::DOUBLE) as avg_before
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date < '2020-06-15'
  GROUP BY age_band
),
after_age_band AS (
  SELECT age_band, AVG(sales::DOUBLE) as avg_after
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date > '2020-06-15'
  GROUP BY age_band
),
age_band_pct AS (
  SELECT (a.avg_after - b.avg_before) / b.avg_before * 100 as pct_change
  FROM before_age_band b JOIN after_age_band a ON b.age_band = a.age_band
),
before_demographic AS (
  SELECT demographic, AVG(sales::DOUBLE) as avg_before
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date < '2020-06-15'
  GROUP BY demographic
),
after_demographic AS (
  SELECT demographic, AVG(sales::DOUBLE) as avg_after
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date > '2020-06-15'
  GROUP BY demographic
),
demographic_pct AS (
  SELECT (a.avg_after - b.avg_before) / b.avg_before * 100 as pct_change
  FROM before_demographic b JOIN after_demographic a ON b.demographic = a.demographic
),
before_customer_type AS (
  SELECT customer_type, AVG(sales::DOUBLE) as avg_before
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date < '2020-06-15'
  GROUP BY customer_type
),
after_customer_type AS (
  SELECT customer_type, AVG(sales::DOUBLE) as avg_after
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date > '2020-06-15'
  GROUP BY customer_type
),
customer_type_pct AS (
  SELECT (a.avg_after - b.avg_before) / b.avg_before * 100 as pct_change
  FROM before_customer_type b JOIN after_customer_type a ON b.customer_type = a.customer_type
),
all_results AS (
  SELECT 'region' as attr_type, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change FROM region_pct
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'platform', AVG(pct_change) FROM platform_pct
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'age_band', AVG(pct_change) FROM age_band_pct
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'demographic', AVG(pct_change) FROM demographic_pct
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'customer_type', AVG(pct_change) FROM customer_type_pct
)
SELECT attr_type, avg_pct_change FROM all_results ORDER BY avg_pct_change
